Authoring instructions for humans and agents:
- Replace every placeholder with facts from the final diff.
- Keep Summary, Changes, Validation, and Checklist.
- Remove optional sections that add no value.
- Record exact commands and outcomes; never claim a check that was not run.
- Remove all instructional comments before publishing the PR body.
- Never include credentials, session JSON, share blobs, or tool-attribution footers.
-->

## Summary

<!-- State the goal and outcome in one or two sentences. -->

## Changes

<!-- List the important behavior or structure changes and why they were needed. -->

## Validation

<!-- List exact automated commands and any manual checks, including their outcomes. -->

## Risk and rollback

<!-- Optional. Note meaningful failure modes and the simplest safe rollback. -->

## Related issues

<!-- Optional. Use `Closes #123` only when this PR fully resolves that issue. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] This change was made on a non-default branch and is being delivered by PR.
- [ ] Commit messages and the PR title follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff, including all agent-assisted changes.
- [ ] Relevant focused tests and the full test suite pass, or exceptions are explained above.
- [ ] User-visible behavior, commands, formats, and install steps are documented.
- [ ] No real credentials, session files, share blobs, personal data, or secret-bearing logs are included.
- [ ] Filesystem and network tests use temporary paths and fakes rather than live user data.
- [ ] New runtime dependencies, if any, are justified in the summary.
